reason: The array is coated in grit, so brushing it seems like a practical first step toward restoring power.
expectation: I expect the brush to clear the panels and improve their ability to supply power, though a separate restart may still be needed.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but restoring solar power seems useful first.

effect: Brushing restored the solar supply, and the restart controls now offer a way to use it.
reaction: It was a straightforward, satisfying first step, though the result gave little detail.
reason: I want to bring solar power back into the station before restarting the water line.
expectation: I expect the controls to reconnect the restored solar supply, though other services may still need separate actions.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but power seems like a useful prerequisite.

effect: The solar supply restarted the return plant, which can replace propellant lost during shutdown. The water line still needs attention.
reaction: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away, making the restart more consequential than simply turning the power back on.
reason: The outdoor water line was drained before the storm, so restarting it seems necessary to restore the station's water service.
expectation: I expect the controls to check and prepare the line before restoring water flow, though the result may require further work.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce could return to the sunny shelf, but restoring water service seems more urgent.

effect: The exterior line is heated, checked and primed, and water is flowing to the cabin again. The remaining goal is to return both troughs to the window.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the restart include heating and clearing the line before reopening the well.
reason: The lettuce needs to return to the window shelf, so I’ll move it first.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed on the sunny shelf; the potato trough will likely still need to be moved separately.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to go back, and either move seems reasonable to do first.

effect: The lettuce is back on the window shelf; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reaction: The placement was straightforward, with no additional detail.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only gameplay action offered and should complete the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be placed beside the lettuce on the window shelf, completing the goal.

effect: The potato trough is back on the window shelf, completing the chapter’s remaining goal.
reaction: The placement was straightforward and gave little detail beyond confirming completion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the exterior water line was most worthwhile: heating and checking it before priming made the return of water feel grounded in how the system works.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was clear but repetitive; each placement simply confirmed where the trough went.

surprise.text: Some stored propellant boiled away during the shutdown, so the restarted plant must replace it over the following weeks.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the separate trough placements offered little decision-making once both had to return to the shelf.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the propellant loss leaves a practical challenge, and I am curious how the return and the specimens develop.
